messages:
maya: Huge thanks to everyone who jumped in on the late-night deploy hiccup — you turned panic into a demo that actually impressed. :sparkles:
oscar: shoutout to @lee for spotting the bad env var in the canary. quick revert fixed it. :clap:
lee: added a tiny preflight check to the deploy script and pushed a one-liner to the infra repo:
```bash
./deploy.sh --preflight || exit 1
```
ops-bot: [auto] Deploy DC-4021 rolled back to v1.11.3; health checks stable. See https://infra.internal/deploys/DC-4021
grace: donating $25 to the cookie jar and dropping a dozen cookies in the kitchen tomorrow AM. stickers for the rescue squad? yes pls. :cookie:
maya: cookies + stickers = morale win. I'll add the new preflight to the runbook and send a quick note in #eng. thanks team ":heart:"
